reviews.body:
Thanks for following up on #1004 with the Vue side, and for setting up the test project for the package while you were at it.

I pulled this down and ran it: both tests pass with the change and both fail without it, so the tests are doing their job. The fix itself looks right to me. Core never reads `themeData` from the config, so the load listener is the only place it can be applied today.

One thing to fix before merge:

- [ ] Lint is red on import order in `packages/vue/tests/dotlottie-vue.spec.ts` and `packages/vue/vitest.config.ts`. Running `pnpm format` from the root sorts both.

Not blocking, just noting: `load` is dispatched on a `setTimeout` after the first frame is already drawn, so the animation can show its default colors for a frame before the theme lands. React has the same behaviour after #1004. The real fix is in core, next to where `themeId` is re-applied on load. I'll take that as a follow-up, no need to do it here.

review_comments.body: Biome wants the `type` imports ahead of the value imports here (same for the `../src` pair below). `pnpm format` fixes it.
nit: the comment can be one line, e.g. `// core clears theme data on every load`. The rest is clear from the code.
